40,49: Talk to Lady Servil, west-southwest of the Monastery south of Ardougne.
Search the chest to the east for some Khazard armour.
Equip Khazard armour, talk to the Khazard Guard in the southeast of the prison.
Buy Khali brew from the nearby bar to the west for 5 coins.
Take the brew back to the Khazard Guard.
Get another set of keys from the Khazard Guard
Get ready to fight the monsters (all safespottable), starting with Khazard Ogre (level 63). Use the keys on Sammy's cell door to free him.
Kill the Ogre. You can lure it behind a skeleton to safespot it.
Talk to Sammy, then fight the ogre.
Kill the Scorpion. You can lure it behind a skeleton to safespot it.
Talk to Sammy, then fight the scorpion.
Kill Bouncer. You can lure it behind a skeleton to safespot it. Warning: After Bouncer is killed, you will be unable to re-enter the arena.
Talk to Sammy, then fight Bouncer.
Exit the arena (can ignore General Khazard). Warning: You will be unable to re-enter the arena.
Go back to Lady Servil to end the quest.
